request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Site S-SFX-001 in Sfax dropped off the air in the early hours of this morning. Is this an outage we need to escalate? Now: 2026-09-03 09:00 (Thursday, Africa/Tunis). Data after thi

response.text:
The evidence shows that site S-SFX-001 experienced a complete drop in availability and traffic from 03:00 to 05:00 on 2026-09-03 (T1, ALR-0003). Crucially, maintenance window MW-0001 reveals a scheduled battery swap directly on S-SFX-001 during this exact timeframe (03:00 to 05:00) with an expected impact of "site down" (T5). There are no alarms, unplanned changes, or transport/core failures associated with this incident (T3, T4). Therefore, this was a planned maintenance activity rather than an unexpected outage requiring escalation.

No further tool calls are needed.
